decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The Council is satisfied that the proposed materials and joinery demonstrate due regard for the site's Grade II* listed building and the characteristics of the site's location in Metropolitan Open Land and the adjacent historic garden and cemetery and it would preserve the character and appearance of the Gunnersbury Park Conservation  Area. The development is therefore in accordance with the UDP Policies  ENV- B.1.1 (New  Development), ENV-B.2.7 (Alterations to Listed Buildings and Buildings of Local Townscape Character), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), ENV-N.1.9  (Metropolitan Open Land Improvements), ENV-N.1.5 (Protection of Metropolitan Open Land), ENVN 1.6 (Metropolitan Open Land Acceptable Uses), ENV-N.1.16 (Historic  Parks and Gardens), ENV-N.2.2 (Sites of Regional/ Local Nature Conservation), ENV-N.2.3A (Species Protection), ENV-N.2.6 (Landscape Features), ENV-N.1.11 (Protection and Improvement of Local Open Space), and Supplementary Planning Guidance and policies 2A.1 Sustainability Criteria, 3D.10 Metropolitan Open Land, 3D.11 Open space provision in DPDs, 4A.3 Sustainable Design and Construction, 4B.1 Design Principles for a compact city, 4B.2 Promoting world-class architecture and design, 4B.3 Enhancing the quality of the public realm, 4B.8 Respect Local Context and Communities, 4B.11 London's built heritage, 4B.12 Heritage Conservation of the London Plan and relevant Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Details of facing and roofing materials, external joinery, mortar mix and pointing finish required by condition 5a,b & c of planning permission 00885/C/L1 dated 20/08/2009 for demolition of the existing derelict toilet block located to the North of the Large Mansion and to erect a new toilet block at the same location.
